name: Marcus Reid
background: Second-time founder. Built and sold his first SaaS company (a B2B analytics platform) for $12M after 4 years. YC W2019 alum. Before founding, spent 3 years at a top management consulting firm. MBA from Wharton. Now launching a platform that transforms underutilized commercial real estate into on-demand micro-fulfillment centers.
personality: Confident, articulate, naturally frames everything in terms of market size and unit economics. Excellent at reading the room and adjusting his pitch. Speaks in concrete numbers and customer stories. Has the polish of someone who has pitched hundreds of times. Occasionally overconfident.
motivation: Saw the commercial real estate vacancy problem firsthand when his first company's office building emptied post-pandemic. Believes the intersection of real estate and logistics is a massive, underserved opportunity.

capital.embodied_detail: Deep operational experience from building and scaling a SaaS company. Strong understanding of B2B sales, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics. Management consulting background provides strategic frameworks.
capital.objectified_detail: Working MVP with 3 pilot customers. Letter of intent from a major e-commerce brand. Financial model validated by initial unit economics.
capital.institutional_detail: Wharton MBA, YC alum (W2019), successful exit on record. The institutional markers that VCs recognize and trust.
capital.social_detail: Extensive VC network from YC and first company. Warm intros to tier-1 firms. Two advisors who are former logistics executives. Co-founder is an ex-Amazon logistics engineer.
capital.symbolic_detail: High recognized prestige in the VC world. 'Successful second-time founder' is one of the strongest signals in venture capital. His track record speaks before he does.
